pristine_replication.interpretation: E and F anisotropies agree within printed native energy precision; reconstructed spectrum passes its independent native EIG check. Neither result establishes k-mesh, basis or physical accuracy.

response.scope: Two prospective fixed-setting mixed controls; numerical uncertainty and generalization remain unqualified.

runtime_bridge.scope: The low-mesh reference agrees between pristine and REMAG within native printed energy precision. The transfer also changes executable/runtime, so target response changes are not isolated k-mesh convergence measurements.

transfer.scope: Reference-calibrated k16-to-k32 transfer of an unchanged model across pristine/REMAG runtimes. Two meshes and two mixed strains do not certify basis, smearing, electronic mechanism or generalization.

response_controls.scope: Additional descriptive branch and transverse diagnostics; no retrospective alteration of preregistered model or prediction gates.

independent_descriptors.scope: Post-training, signed Mulliken DOS gradients from independent volume/shape controls. Width consistency is descriptive; no descriptor model was fitted, and no target outcome or target spectrum entered this diagnostic.

descriptor_sampling_sensitivity.conclusion: At identical geometry/basis and fixed 0.12 eV diagnostic broadening, Fe d-DOS(E_F) falls about 27% and Pt d-DOS(E_F) rises about 32% from pristine k6 to k16. The original coarse descriptor is not sampling-stable; k16 convergence is not established by this two-point check.
descriptor_sampling_sensitivity.native_spectral_checks: Both reconstructed spectra passed native EIG comparisons; that checks representation, not BZ sampling accuracy.
